name: Gurda Ragescar
summary: Gurda Ragescar fell at a Horde camp southwest of Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. She and Feran Strongwind died defending it against dangers in the shadowed forest.

sections.title: A Slain Outpost
sections.body: Gurda Ragescar and her guards fell at a small Horde camp southwest of Splintertree Post. The outpost stood beneath Ashenvale's dense canopy, deep in territory contested by night elven defenders and wild beasts. Gurda and Feran Strongwind were killed when the camp was overrun. Only remnants of their last stand remain for passing allies to find.

sections.title: The Fallen Scouts
sections.body: Travelers near the trail may find the scene of Gurda's defeat. The camp's possessions and unfinished work point to Horde efforts across the woods, including missing documents and orders disrupted by the ambush.

faq.answer: Gurda Ragescar was an orc scout at a small Horde camp southwest of Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. She died with her companions when the outpost was overrun.

faq.q: Where can Gurda Ragescar be found?
faq.answer: Her body lies at an overrun camp southwest of Splintertree Post, off the road through central Ashenvale.
Feran Strongwind and their guards died beside her when their small camp was attacked.
Gurda is tied to The Lost Pages, which involves recovering scattered documents in the Ashenvale wilderness.

angles.text: For the Horde, Gurda's fallen camp marks the cost of securing a foothold in Ashenvale's forests.
